newsitem.title: USA: Salomon Inc stake held by Dart Financial.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Inc stake held by Dart Financial.

text.p: Dart Financial Corp said Tuesday it holds 5,472,500 shares of Salomon Inc, or a 5.2 percent stake.
The stake is held for long-term passive investment purposes, Dart said.
Dart Financial is a private trust company affilated with Dart Container Corp, a Grand Cayman Islands-based company that is a large manufacturer of polystyrene cups and plastic cutlery and dinnerware.

A filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission said Ross Financial Corp, an affiliate of Dart Financial, holds the bulk of the stake -- 5,429,500 shares. Ross purchased the stake for about $209 million.

On October 17, 1995, Dart Financial said it had sold the bulk of its stake in Salomon, reducing its holding to 0.04 percent from 7.6 percent and leaving Dart and its affiliates with just 43,000 Salomon shares.

Ross Financial began buying Salomon shares again on Oct 30, 1995, and continued its buys until March 13, 1996. It resumed its purchases on Oct 22, 1996, and since then has purchased 1,879,400 shares at prices ranging from $44.50 to $45 per share.
